title: Pricey but worth every euro!
text: Everything about this trip was absolutely amazing! Pedro and Carmen were amazing drivers and escorts around town! They went above and beyond for us the entire day! We highly recommend them both! Sow was a fantastic guide for the Alhambra! He knows EVERYTHING and makes it all very interesting! He is well known and loved by all the staff and knows exactly how to avoid all the big tour groups so we had many spaces all to ourselves. Be sure to request Sow, the BEST Alhambra guide!
author: Lauri_L

title: Excellent tour
text: Our guides Carmen and Pedro were very good. Our guide in Alhambra Alba was excellent. All together it was very nice excursion, recommendable for elder people.
author: Dragan_S

title: Another Bucket List Visited and Experienced !
text: This was the most fun I’d had with my wife on this trip . Not only Pedro picked us up on time and treated us like his friends ,  the personal touches throughout the entire trip was amazing. Juan the master guide at Alhambra was amazing and so knowledgeable.  This was once in a lifetime experience for anyone .  There is no doubt this is worth every single penny !  Enjoy it
author: John_L

title: Excellent Day Trip from Seville
text: Great way to see this amazing city--it is a long day but it is so worth it--very informative and wonderful site to see
author: Fidelma_R

title: Great experience. As...
text: Great experience. As mentioned in the description, the tickets are purchased last minute (appears to be resale tickets whatever is available), and thus you must be flexible regarding timing. For our group, we heard about whether tickets were found and the time of the trip the night before around 10pm. We were told that the only available tickets were at 9:30AM, so we would be picked up by our driver in Seville at 6:30AM. title: Tour guide was great and...
text: Tour guide was great and very knowledgeable of the area and history.  Great tour. Long drive from Seville and we were grateful to have a driver to and from Granada as a day trip.
author: Erin_K

title: A Fabulous Experience
text:
Alhambra is an amazing place and a must to see.
We had a fabulous tour guide, Sol, who had incredible knowledge of this magnificent place. His love of history and Alhambra made the tour quite exceptional.
author: Diane_P
